Trump Cancels and Reinstates Weekend Rallies in Iowa and Kansas

Former President Donald Trump initially canceled weekend rallies scheduled for Kansas and Iowa but later reinstated them. The rallies were part of Republican efforts to retain control of the Senate and House ahead of the midterms. Trump held events in Iowa and Kansas.
